name: hbm_su_pg_lgtap_1017

pin_regs.reason: Every boundary bit already has its register in RTL: each static LG tap registers its local/far/near inputs at the pins and its mux/output stage; rst_n lands in the serial source flop of the synchroniser. Wrapper flops would add edges to the fixed VM calendar (10/7).

structural_change: HBM-SU3 10-17 (coordinator 0dg+3): SU-level LG pair tap hardened as its own leaf beside the pgslice VM bank leaves, with a reviewed 1-bit serial->stream reset synchroniser (clk_ctl rc -> pg_clk rs[0] -> rs[1]) instead of the r8b single pg_clk flop of the serial rst_n. Datapath = unchanged ot_hbm_vm_lg_pair_tap (10/7). Pin-bound 216x216 as the CLOSED SFU tap leaf: W far 1,112 / E near 1,112 / N local requests 596 full face / S local returns 516 + clocks/reset/selects at the S centre. Benches: tools/hbm_static/su_pg_lg_tap_rsync_run.sh (tap lockstep vs ot_hbm_vm_lg_pair_tap + exact reset edges; RSYNC_MUT=1 = r8b one-flop reset FAILS) and su_pgslice_lg_rsync_run.sh (whole pgslice_lg RSYNC=1 vs r8b at die params, leaf + tap synchronisers agree). NATIVE-FIX3/lgtap 10-18 (NATIVE-3 audit claude/native-3-1017 73adc87ea: routed r1-139da60d3 local_rr launch 319.2 ps on 154 of 514 bits, local_rq[16]/[33] capture 236.3/225.9, local_wq[561] 219.1): LOCAL_SPLIT=1 (wrapper default; the SFU/HC pair-tap leaves keep 0). (a) local_rr data gets its own return register per bank (ot_hbm_vm_lg_keep_reg, kept through synthesis) so the S-face local_rr and W-face far_rr copies each sit at their face (r1 shared one register between both faces); (b) the read/write calendars are filled from the pin registers (read_d&lrq_v, write_d&lwq_v) one edge later with the due tap one entry earlier, so every local_rq/local_wq valid pin and local_read/local_write pin has a single capture flop. 0 added edges (cycles_added 0, VM calendar 10/7 unchanged): lockstep vs the LOCAL_SPLIT=0 pair tap bit-identical on every output at every edge (PASS checks=36024); SPLIT_MUT 1 (due tap one entry late) and 2 (local copy fed from the near_rr pins) FAIL lockstep. Same outline and pin plan as r1.

job.purpose: HBM die d4f su_<q><g> (ot_hbm_su_static_pgslice_lg) LG tap child with a real reset synchroniser (0dg+3)

cdc_synchronizers.name: pg_reset
cdc_synchronizers.why: serial power-on reset rst_n (pin flop rc on clk_ctl) re-timed by two pg_clk flops into the taps reset (replaces the r8b single pg_clk flop of the raw serial rst_n; same pattern as col_su r3 stream_reset)

reroute_reason.why: OWNERS-HBM native audit (claude/owners-hbm-native-1018 61ccb4897, lanes/OWNERS-HBM_logs/NATIVE-HBM.md; = NATIVE-3 claude/native-3-1017 73adc87ea): local_rr[490] 319.2 ps (154 of 514 local_rr bits 290-319), local_rq[16] 236.3 / local_rq[33] 225.9 / local_wq[561] 219.1 capture -> per-face local return register + pin-register-fed calendars (LOCAL_SPLIT=1, 0 cycles); native_launch does not apply because the RTL changes
reroute_reason.fix: LOCAL_SPLIT=1: local_rr from its own kept return register at the S face (far_rr keeps return_d at the W face); calendar head from the local valid/select pin registers so each local request pin has one capture flop; 0 added edges, lockstep bit-identical; LGTAP2 10-18: ot_hbm_vm_lg_keep_reg unparameterised so SYNTH_KEEP_MODULES matches it (r2 gate CTS probe: the \$paramod copy was flattened and folded into return_d, local_rr 329.7 ps from the W face)
